title: pydantic-ai
summary: Pydantic-AI is a comprehensive framework for building, deploying, and evaluating AI agents. It provides core abstractions for interacting with Large Language Models, managing agent capabilities and tools, and ensuring durable execution. Developers can seamlessly integrate with various LLM providers, create interactive user interfaces, and rigorously assess agent performance.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Developer / User
nodes.description: Represents the human user or developer who interacts with the Pydantic-AI framework to build, deploy, and evaluate AI agents.

nodes.label: Core AI Agent Framework
nodes.title: Core AI Agent Framework
nodes.description: The foundational framework for building, running, and extending AI agents, providing core abstractions for LLM interaction, agent capabilities, tool management, and durable execution.

nodes.label: LLM & External Service Integrations
nodes.title: LLM & External Service Integrations
nodes.description: Connects the core framework to a wide array of external Large Language Model (LLM) providers, embedding services, and other third-party tools, offering a unified integration layer.

nodes.label: User Interface & Protocol Server
nodes.title: User Interface & Protocol Server
nodes.description: Provides components for integrating Pydantic-AI agents with various user interfaces and for implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, handling interaction and deployment.

nodes.label: AI Agent Evaluation Framework
nodes.title: AI Agent Evaluation Framework
nodes.description: A comprehensive framework for defining, configuring, and executing both online and dataset-based evaluations, including LLM-driven dataset generation and various evaluator types.

nodes.label: Foundational Utilities & Graph Engine
nodes.title: Foundational Utilities & Graph Engine
nodes.description: Aggregates foundational utilities, including a graph processing framework for complex workflows, tools for documentation generation, and scripts for testing and cloud integration verification.

groups.label: Agent Core & Orchestration
groups.title: Agent Core & Orchestration
groups.description: This group encompasses the central components for defining, orchestrating, and executing AI agents, along with the foundational utilities and graph processing engine that support complex workflows.

groups.label: External Service Connectivity
groups.title: External Service Connectivity
groups.description: This group manages all external connections, providing seamless integration with diverse Large Language Model providers, embedding services, and other third-party AI tools.

groups.label: Interaction & Deployment
groups.title: Interaction & Deployment
groups.description: This group focuses on how agents interact with users and other systems, offering frameworks for building user interfaces and implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for broader deployment.

groups.label: Quality Assurance & Evaluation
groups.title: Quality Assurance & Evaluation
groups.description: Dedicated to ensuring the quality and performance of AI agents, this group provides a robust framework for defining, running, and analyzing evaluations, including various assessment types and reporting tools.
